_game: ViZDoom: Defend the Center (Doom action-shooter; COOM engine)
_note: pip install vizdoom. Doom scenario via ViZDoom's gymnasium envs. Try other Vizdoom*-v1 ids (DeadlyCorridor, HealthGathering, TakeCover, Deathmatch, ...).
_keys_note: Action indices are scenario-specific. For VizdoomDefendCenter-v1 the Discrete(4) map is 0=noop, 1=ATTACK, 2=TURN_RIGHT, 3=TURN_LEFT (verify with env.unwrapped.button_map). The controls the subject sees are a plain 'message' phase (hardcoded string, edit freely); keep its text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

curriculum.text:
Defend the Center

You're surrounded. Turn to face the monsters and
shoot them before they reach you.

Controls:
   LEFT    turn left
   RIGHT   turn right
   SPACE   shoot

(press SPACE to start)
